name: Gorz the Emissary of Darkness
extDescription:
When you take damage from a card your opponent controls: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You must control no cards to activate and to resolve this effect. When Special Summoned this way, activate the appropriate effect, based on the type of damage:
Battle Damage: Special Summon 1 "Emissary of Darkness Token" (Fairy-Type/LIGHT/Level 7/ATK ?/DEF ?). Its ATK and DEF are each equal to the amount of Battle Damage you took.
Effect Damage: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the amount of damage you took.

name: Jinzo
extDescription: Trap Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. The effects of all face-up Trap Cards on the field are negated.

name: Parasite Paracide
extDescription: FLIP: Put this card face-up in your opponent's Deck and shuffle it. When your opponent draws this card, it is Special Summoned to their side of the field in face-up Defense Position, and inflicts 1000 damage to them. Then, while this card is face-up on the field, all monsters your opponent controls become Insect-Type monsters.

name: Lightforce Sword
extDescription: Banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand, face-down. During your opponent's 4th Standby Phase after this card's activation, return that card to their hand.

name: Chain Destruction
extDescription: When a monster(s) with 2000 or less ATK is Summoned: Target 1 of them; destroy all cards with that name in its controller's hand and Main Deck.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand.

name: Call of the Haunted
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Mirror Wall
extDescription: Each of your opponent's monsters that conducted an attack while this card was face-up on the field has its ATK halved as long as this card remains on the field. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 2000 Life Points or destroy this card.

name: Appropriate
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent draws a card(s), except during their Draw Phase. Draw 2 cards.

name: Ceasefire
extDescription: Flip all face-down Defense Position monsters face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each face-up Effect Monster on the field.

name: Magical Hats
extDescription: During your opponent's Battle Phase: Choose 2 non-Monster Cards from your Deck and 1 monster you control. Shuffle those 3 cards and Set them on the field in Defense Position. The 2 cards chosen from your Deck are treated as Normal Monsters (ATK 0/DEF 0) and are destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase.

name: Nobleman of Crossout
extDescription: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it instead of sending it to the Graveyard, then, if it was a Flip Effect Monster, both players reveal their Main Decks, and banish all cards with that monster's name from both Decks.

name: Premature Burial
extDescription: Activate this card by paying 800 Life Points, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Buster Blader
extDescription: This card gains 500 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster your opponent controls or is in their Graveyard.

name: Skull Invitation
extDescription: Each time a card(s) is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 300 damage to its owner for each card sent.

name: Limiter Removal
extDescription: Double the ATK of all Machine-Type monsters you controlled at both the activation and resolution of this card, until the End Phase. During the End Phase, destroy those monsters.

name: Insect Imitation
extDescription: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is 1 higher than the Tributed monster's.

name: Magic Drain
extDescription: When your opponent activates a Spell Card: They can discard 1 Spell Card to negate this card's effect, otherwise negate the activation of their Spell Card, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Gravity Bind
extDescription: Level 4 or higher monsters cannot attack.

name: The Legendary Fisherman
extDescription: While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
extDescription:
"Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol"
Other monsters cannot change their battle position or attack. Once per turn, you can equip 1 monster your opponent controls to this card (max 1). This card's ATK and DEF become the same as the equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead.

name: 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom
extDescription: FLIP: Destroy all Level 4 monsters your opponent controls.

name: Mad Sword Beast
extDescription: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Goblin Attack Force
extDescription: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the End Phase of your next turn.

name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
extDescription: When an Equip Card(s) is equipped to this card: Destroy the Equip Card(s).

name: The Masked Beast
extDescription: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Curse of the Masked Beast".

name: Revival Jam
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can pay 1000 Life Points; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position during your next turn's Standby Phase.

name: Curse of the Masked Beast
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon "The Masked Beast". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Mask of Restrict
extDescription: Cards cannot be Tributed.

name: Lightning Blade
extDescription: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK. All WATER monsters lose 500 ATK.

name: Tornado Wall
extDescription: Activate only while "Umi" is on the field. While "Umi" is face-up on the field, you take no Battle Damage from attacking monsters. Destroy this card when "Umi" leaves the field.

name: Torrential Tribute
extDescription: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Infinite Cards
extDescription: There is no limit to the number of cards in players' hands.

name: Jam Defender
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a monster you control: You can target 1 "Revival Jam" you control; switch the attack target to that target.

name: Card of Safe Return
extDescription: When a monster is Special Summoned from your Graveyard, you can draw 1 card.

name: United We Stand
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK and DEF for each face-up monster you control.

name: Mage Power
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK and DEF for each Spell/Trap Card you control.

name: Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer
extDescription: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target up to 2 monsters in their Graveyard; banish those targets. Your opponent cannot banish cards from either player's Graveyard.

name: Bazoo the Soul-Eater
extDescription: Once per turn: You can banish up to 3 monsters from your Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK for each, until your opponent's End Phase.

name: Dark Necrofear
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 Fiend-Type monsters from your Graveyard. During the End Phase, if this card was destroyed by an opponent's card this turn (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to the Graveyard while it was a Monster Card in your possession: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip this card from the Graveyard to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster by this effect, take control of that monster.

name: Gilasaurus
extDescription: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When you do: Your opponent can target 1 monster in their Graveyard; your opponent Special Summons that target to their side of the field.

name: Dark Spirit of the Silent
extDescription: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Negate that attack, and select another face-up monster your opponent controls. That monster attacks instead. (If it is in face-up Defense Position, change it to Attack Position.)

name: Destiny Board
extDescription: At the end of each of your opponent's turns, place 1 "Spirit Message" card from your hand or your Deck face-up on the field. If you control the "Spirit Message" cards "I", "N", "A", and "L" in the proper order, you win the Duel. If any "Spirit Message" cards or "Destiny Board" you control is removed from the field, all "Spirit Message" cards and "Destiny Board" you control are sent to the Graveyard.

name: Spirit Message "I"
extDescription: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Spirit Message "N"
extDescription: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Spirit Message "A"
extDescription: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Spirit Message "L"
extDescription: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Magic Cylinder
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

name: Yata-Garasu
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they skip their next Draw Phase.

name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
extDescription: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend-Type monsters you control.

name: Freed the Matchless General
extDescription: Negate any Spell effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Emergency Provisions
extDescription: Send any number of other Spell and Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard. Gain 1000 Life Points for each card sent.

name: Tyrant Dragon
extDescription: During your Battle Phase, if your opponent controls a monster after this card's first attack, this card can make a second attack. Negate any Trap effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard, unless you Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster.

name: Spear Dragon
extDescription: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Airknight Parshath
extDescription: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

name: Yamata Dragon
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

name: Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw.

name: Asura Priest
extDescription: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

name: A Legendary Ocean
extDescription: This card's name is treated as "Umi". Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both player's hands and on the field by 1. All WATER monsters gain 200 ATK and DEF.

name: Creature Swap
extDescription: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: Bottomless Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

name: Injection Fairy Lily
extDescription: If this card attacks or is attacked, during damage calculation (in either player's turn): You can pay 2000 Life Points once per battle; this card gains 3000 ATK during that damage calculation only.

name: Ring of Destruction
extDescription: During your opponent’s turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to their LP; destroy that face-up monster, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. You can only activate 1 “Ring of Destruction” per turn.

name: Guardian Sphinx
extDescription: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Return all monsters your opponent controls to the hand.

name: Don Zaloog
extDescription:
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
Discard 1 random card from their hand.
Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Book of Taiyou
extDescription: Flip 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position.

name: Book of Moon
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

name: Reckless Greed
extDescription: Draw 2 cards and skip your next 2 Draw Phases.

name: Dark Jeroid
extDescription: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

name: Newdoria
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Helpoemer
extDescription: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. If this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, this effect activates at the end of each of your opponent's Battle Phases: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand. This card must be in the Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Gravekeeper's Spy
extDescription: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

name: Gravekeeper's Chief
extDescription: You can only control 1 face-up "Gravekeeper's Chief". Your Graveyard is unaffected by "Necrovalley". When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
extDescription: When this card declares an attack while "Necrovalley" is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

name: Dark Room of Nightmare
extDescription: Each time your opponent takes damage from a card effect, except "Dark Room of Nightmare", inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

name: Necrovalley
extDescription:
New Font Errata: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in either player's Graveyard cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the Graveyard, other than itself, to a different place.

Negate the effects of Spell, Trap, and Monster Cards that affect a card(s) in the Graveyard. Neither player can remove from play cards in the Graveyard. All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF.

name: Barrel Behind the Door
extDescription: Activate only when a card's effect that would inflict damage to you is activated. Your opponent takes the damage instead.

name: Nightmare Wheel
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Lava Golem
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's side of the field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. During each of the controller's Standby Phases: The controller takes 1000 damage.

name: Morphing Jar
extDescription: FLIP: Both players discard all the cards in their hands, then draw 5 cards.

name: Royal Decree
extDescription: Negate all other Trap Card effects on the field.

name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
extDescription: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon it without Tributing.

name: Obnoxious Celtic Guard
extDescription: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or more ATK.

name: Kaiser Sea Horse
extDescription: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT monster.

name: Insect Queen
extDescription: This card cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster. This card gains 200 ATK for each Insect-Type monster on the field. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle this turn: Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

name: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" from your hand and/or your side of the field. You can Tribute this card to target 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" in your Graveyard; Special Summon those targets.

name: Harpie's Pet Dragon
extDescription: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each "Harpie Lady" on the field.

name: Archfiend of Gilfer
extDescription: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip that target with this card. That monster loses 500 ATK while equipped with this card.

name: Light and Darkness Dragon
extDescription: Cannot be Special Summoned. While face-up on the field, this card is also DARK-Attribute. Once per Chain, during either player's turn, when a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated: This card loses exactly 500 ATK and DEF and that activation is negated. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard (if possible); destroy all cards you control, also Special Summon that monster (if any).

name: Blue-Eyes Shining Dragon
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" you control. This card gains 300 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard. You can negate the effects of Spells, Traps, and Effect Monsters that target this card.

name: Dragon Master Knight
extDescription:
"Black Luster Soldier" + "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 500 ATK for each face-up Dragon-Type monster you control, except this card.

name: Victory Dragon
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned. To Tribute Summon this card, you must Tribute 3 Dragon-Type monsters. If this card attacks your opponent directly and reduces their Life Points to 0, you win the Match.

name: Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest
cleanName: Green Baboon Defender of the Forest
extDescription: If this card is in your hand or Graveyard when a face-up Beast-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 1000 Life Points; Special Summon this card.

name: Dreadscythe Harvester
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 Insect-Type monster to have this card gain 500 ATK until the end of the turn.

name: Retro Pack 2 Booster Pack
extDescription:
Go back in time with Retro Pack 2!

This 100-card set boasts the most sought-after cards from Pharaoh’s Servant, Labyrinth of Nightmare, Legacy of Darkness, and Pharaonic Guardian. Plus, Retro Pack 2 contains many limited print and hard to get cards including “Light and Darkness Dragon” from SHONEN JUMP Magazine and “Blue-Eyes Shining Dragon” from Yu-Gi-Oh! the Movie!

Retro Pack 2 contains 100 cards:
• 48 Common Cards (8:1)
• 24 Rare Cards (1:1)
• 10 Super Rare Cards (1:5)
• 8 Ultra Rare Cards (1:12)
